lines.text: Flying into Kingston? Do this before you board.
Fill in the immigration and customs C5 form online, and make your customs declaration before you arrive.
Your passport must stay valid for your whole stay, and your airline's rules may be stricter.
At customs, declare anything prohibited or subject to duty, and leave meat and dairy products at home.
And never carry anything through customs for anyone else.
Then pick your ride: transfer, approved taxi or rental. The comparison link is in the description. If you book through our links we may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you.
